mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates a shift toward monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of macro-easing windows, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of tightening episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of strong-labor episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 150,000 jobs triggers a risk-on reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of weak-labor episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 102.5 signals robust manufacturing momentum, which supports corporate earnings forecasts and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of high-INDPRO months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of low-INDPRO months, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of high-HOUST months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 1,000 units triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of low-HOUST months, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
